item.title: Core–Shell Co@v‐CoO x /C Electrocatalysts With Balanced Intermediate Adsorption for High‐Performance Rechargeable Zinc–Air Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a metal-core-buffered vacancy-shell strategy: metallic Co nanodots act as an electron reservoir that buffers vacancy-induced polarized Co─O─C motifs, weakening excessive *OH binding and balancing oxygen activation with site regeneration. This enables superior bifunctional ORR/OER activity and record ~3200 h Zn-air battery cycling, advancing vacancy-engineered electrocatalyst design.
🏷 Zn-air battery · Co@CoOx core-shell · oxygen electrocatalysis · vacancy engineering · bifunctional catalyst

item.title: Gear‐Meshing Design Reduces Heterointerfacial Mass‐Transfer Barriers for Accelerated Li + Conduction in Composite Polymer Electrolytes
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a gear-meshing interfacial design using polydopamine as a molecular gear-like coupler that meshes polymer chains with Al₂O₃ fillers, improving compatibility and anchoring anions to liberate mobile Li⁺. Combined with a 3D PAN framework, it enables continuous Li⁺ pathways, achieving 0.52 transference number, 0.5 mS cm⁻¹ conductivity, and 4200 h dendrite-free cycling—advancing all-solid-state lithium metal batteries.
🏷 composite polymer electrolyte · Li+ conduction · solid-state battery · polydopamine coating · heterointerface

💡 The novelty lies in using carboxyl-functionalized HATNTA, a π-conjugated HATN derivative, as a molecular interphase engineer for Si anodes.
